text:
Kai: quick post-deploy smoke for connector-service prefill path (ap-south). Canary v1.9.4 rolled 6m ago. Seeing intermittent 503s and p95 jump to ~1.2s on /v1/prefill.

Deploy-bot: Canary finished 5m ago; no automatic rollback.

Kai: tagging @mina  propose HOLD further rollout and pin traffic back to v1.9.3 while we triage.

Mina: ack, checking dashboards. Errors cluster on connect-host-11.

Mina: can we repro with targeted synth against host-9..11 with canary header? smokebot run please.

Kai: smokebot please run 40 reqs, concurrency 4, target hosts 09..11, model header v1.9.4:
```
curl -sS -X POST 'https://synth.redwood/check' \
  -H 'x-region: ap-south' \
  -H 'x-model: v1.9.4' \
  -H 'x-target-hosts: connect-host-09,connect-host-10,connect-host-11' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/prefill","input":"test"}'
```

Smokebot: starting job 3619999999-t1 (40 reqs, concurrency 4).

Smokebot: job complete  results: 5/40 returned 503, p95=1200ms, median=90ms. Failures concentrated on connect-host-11.

Mina: reproducible. grab tcpdump and collector on host-11. Looks like backend handoff delay during warmup.

Kai: decision: pin to v1.9.3 (no DB changes). Mina, flip routing?

Mina: applying pin now  set v1.9.4 -> 0%, v1.9.3 -> 100%. ETA ~60s.

Deploy-bot: Traffic updated  v1.9.4 weight set to 0%. v1.9.3 weight set to 100%. Canary artifact retained for debugging.

Kai: Mina, capture heap/stack and any socket stats from host-11. Commands for reference:
```
sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/host-11.pcap -c 500 -i eth0
sudo jemalloc_ps_dump > /tmp/jemalloc.json
sudo gcore -o /tmp/core $(pgrep connector-service)
```

Mina: started collections and uploading to s3://redwood-debug/3619999999/host-11/.

Ops: change window until 20:45 UTC. If SLOs persist after pin, escalate to oncall.

Kai: opening RED-1502 with synth job 3619999999-t1 and trace links, assigning to runtime/perf.

Mina: will re-run a short validation sweep after pin (20 reqs) to confirm. smokebot start val job.

Smokebot: starting job 3619999999-val1 (20 reqs).

Smokebot: validation complete  0/20 failed, p95=130ms.

Kai: good. Leaving pin in place while we investigate. Moving to RED-1502 for postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
